title: Rav Ada son of Rav Ika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Gittin 84b (Hyman cites 84a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.84b.5); see also the entry Rav Idi son of Rav Ika.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Gittin 84a. The matching statement by Rav Ada son of Rav Ika appears in the William Davidson digital text of Gittin 84b; both locators are retained.

The linked Gittin names Rav Ada son of Rav Ika. [Heilprin’s Rav Acha entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=316&lang=en) discusses this occurrence and regards Ada as a possible scribal error. Hyman cross-references Rav Idi son of Rav Ika, whom [Heilprin’s Rav Idi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=409&lang=en) tentatively connects to Acha.
